paragraphs.text: The Susurians are a race of vampires from the Lip of Susur , the photon collar that rings Point Prime in the Edge .

Susurians are massive beings who lens light around themselves and are born with an inherent command over the trembling gravitational threads of the annular universe . They emerged from the Lip of Susur when the Susur star was reduced to a gravitationally torn carcass. Susur is now called Point Prime and is the first and most holy supervoid of the Monoist faith. The Susurians divined the first tenets of Monoism and founded the faith. They are still part of the Monasteriat.
The Monoists consider the Susurians the twin species to the Astelli .
